name: kb
description: The project's queryable knowledge base — the pull surface the long-lens tools have been missing. Files every piece of knowledge on two orthogonal axes: KIND (which catalog — episodic what-happened, semantic settled-facts, procedural how-we-work; the CoALA taxonomy) x CASTE (which scope tier, narrow to wide — session, thread, project, fleet, owner). Indexes the markdown stores a project already keeps (steward model + log + inbox, handoffs, kickoff prompts, project instructions) with zero configuration; any other store is a config line. Every result reports what it held back and which facet separates the remainder, so an ambiguous ask converges through the conversation itself instead of needing a second agent. 0.2.0 added the MCP adapter: an always-loaded stdio server (kb_query / kb_read / kb_overview, zero dependencies, hand-rolled JSON-RPC) whose tools sit in Claude's toolset every turn — Claude self-serves knowledge mid-work, ReAct-style, with the narrowing hints riding inside each tool result. 0.3.0 adds create + maintain: /kb-seed extracts an EXISTING project's knowledge (docs, git history, code structure) into .claude/kb/extracted/ with owner confirmation, and /kb-capture files one decision/dead-end/finding at a time into .claude/kb/captures/ — both stores are session-written markdown with per-file frontmatter (kind/caste/themes/when override the source spec, so one dir holds mixed kinds); the ENGINE stays read-only permanently, and steward-model changes still route to .steward/inbox/ for recompute.
